# Output

Movies made of several scenes and the transitions between them.

**Contents:**

- [`k.movie`](#k-movie): Composes several scenes into a single output, with one transition per join (`k.cut` when omitted).
- [`k.Movie`](#k-movie-class): Composes several scenes into a single output, with one transition per join (`k.cut` when omitted).
- [`k.cut`](#k-cut): Hard-cut transition between two scenes of a `k.movie` (the default).
- [`k.crossfade`](#k-crossfade): Transition in which the end of one scene dissolves into the start of the next, over `duration` seconds.
- [`k.morph_cut`](#k-morph_cut): Transition in which objects with the same `key=` in neighboring scenes travel across the cut.

Back to the [reference index](README.md).

<a id="k-movie"></a>
### `k.movie` *(function)*

```python
k.movie(
    scenes: Sequence[SceneDef],
    transitions: Sequence[Transition] = (),
    *,
    name: str = "movie",
) -> Movie
```

Composes several scenes into a single output, with one transition per join (`k.cut` when omitted). `kinemo render` renders the movie as a single video.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scenes` | `Sequence[SceneDef]` | required |   |
| `transitions` | `Sequence[Transition]` | `()` | `k.movie([intro, pythagoras], transitions=[k.crossfade(0.5)])`. |
| `name` | `str` | `"movie"` |   |

**Example:**

```python
@k.scene
def intro(s: k.Scene):
    s.play(k.write(k.Text("Chapter 1").place(at="center")))

@k.scene
def body(s: k.Scene):
    s.play(k.draw(k.Circle(r=1.5).place(at="center")))

movie = k.movie([intro, body], transitions=[k.crossfade(0.5)])
```

**See also:** [`k.crossfade`](#k-crossfade), [`k.cut`](#k-cut), [`k.morph_cut`](#k-morph_cut).

<a id="k-cut"></a>
### `k.cut` *(value)*

```python
k.cut: Transition = Transition(kind='cut', duration=0.0)
```

Hard-cut transition between two scenes of a `k.movie` (the default).

**Example:**

```python
@k.scene
def before(s: k.Scene):
    s.play(k.write(k.Text("Before").place(at="center")))

@k.scene
def after(s: k.Scene):
    s.play(k.write(k.Text("After").place(at="center")))

movie = k.movie([before, after], transitions=[k.cut])
```

**See also:** [`k.movie`](#k-movie), [`k.crossfade`](#k-crossfade).

<a id="k-crossfade"></a>
### `k.crossfade` *(function)*

```python
k.crossfade(duration: float = 0.5) -> Transition
```

Transition in which the end of one scene dissolves into the start of the next, over `duration` seconds.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | `float` | `0.5` | Transition in which the end of one scene dissolves into the start of the next, over `duration` seconds. |

**Example:** same as [`k.movie`](#k-movie).

**See also:** [`k.movie`](#k-movie), [`k.cut`](#k-cut), [`k.morph_cut`](#k-morph_cut).

<a id="k-morph_cut"></a>
### `k.morph_cut` *(function)*

```python
k.morph_cut(duration: float = 0.5) -> Transition
```

Transition in which objects with the same `key=` in neighboring scenes travel across the cut.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | `float` | `0.5` |   |

**Example:**

```python
@k.scene
def one(s: k.Scene):
    s.play(k.draw(k.Circle(r=1, key="sun").place(at="left", margin=3)))

@k.scene
def two(s: k.Scene):
    s.play(k.draw(k.Circle(r=1, key="sun").place(at="right", margin=3)))

movie = k.movie([one, two], transitions=[k.morph_cut(0.8)])
```

**See also:** [`k.movie`](#k-movie), [`k.crossfade`](#k-crossfade).
